answer: Time-locked work history split across independent auditors: each epoch's output is signed by the worker, then countersigned by two auditors who never see each other's grade until both are in. Because the split is blind, collusion needs both, and one honest draw voids the pair. Budget the attack in hours. A juniper clone costs the same task time as an honest agent, the jetty of aliases raises no signal, and the cheapest farm burns more hours than it earns.
